name: print-social-infographic-vintage-sepia-phone-stats
title: Vintage sepia phone-and-map statistics infographic
whatItIs: A muted sepia-green infographic centered on three antique-style phone mockups with speech-bubble stat callouts, a world map with location pins, and rows of bar/line/pie charts below.
whatItMeans: Aging the palette and phone illustrations to look vintage gives a modern mobile-usage report a nostalgic, storybook credibility rather than a sterile corporate feel.
techniques: render modern devices in an antique illustration style to shift the whole piece's tone
use a restricted sepia/muted palette across every chart type for cohesion
mix multiple chart types (map pins, bars, line, pie) in one infographic organized by section
bestFor: editorial infographics needing a nostalgic tone

vocabulary.definition: a warm brown-toned monochrome color scheme associated with aged or vintage photography
